questions: Should the function handle tables with nested <table> elements inside the target table (e.g., a table within a table cell)? If so, should the nested table's data be included, ignored, or cause an error?
If the table has <tr> tags but they contain only whitespace or non-data elements (e.g., comments, scripts), should it still return an empty DataFrame or attempt to extract data?
Should the function respect <thead>, <tbody>, <tfoot> sections when extracting headers and data, or treat all <tr> equally?
If the table has rowspan or colspan attributes, how should they be handled? Should the DataFrame reflect merged cells (e.g., with NaN or repeated values)?
Should the function strip whitespace from cell text, or preserve exact formatting including leading/trailing spaces?
If the table contains <th> elements inside data rows (not just in header), should they be treated as headers or data?
Should the function decode HTML entities (e.g., &) in cell text, or leave them as-is?
What is the expected behavior if the table has multiple header rows (e.g., <tr> with <th> in first two rows)? Should they be combined, used as MultiIndex, or only the first row as header?
